+"""JSON Lines artifacts are redacted on their decoded values, not their raw text.
+
+Read raw, `"\\n\\n@mock.patch("` offers the address regex `n@mock.patch`, and an
+address abutting a JSON escape is replaced together with the escape letter, leaving a lone
+backslash: the line stops parsing and code that was never an address is rewritten.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from sphragis.corpus.redact import PLACEHOLDER, addresses_in, redact_file
+
+
+def test_jsonl_redaction_keeps_every_line_parseable(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    records = [
+        {"id": "a", "text": "import x\n\n@mock.patch('y')\ndef test(): pass"},
+        {"id": "b", "text": "Maintainer:\njane@redhat.com\n"},
+        {"id": "c", "text": "plain"},
+    ]
+    original = "".join(json.dumps(r) + "\n" for r in records)
+    path = tmp_path / "inputs.jsonl"
+    path.write_text(original)
+
+    found, redacted = redact_file(path)
+
+    assert found == {"jane@redhat.com"}
+    assert redacted is not None
+    lines = redacted.splitlines(keepends=True)
+    assert len(lines) == 3 and redacted.endswith("\n")
+    rows = [json.loads(line) for line in lines]
+    assert rows[0] == records[0]
+    assert rows[1]["text"] == f"Maintainer:\n{PLACEHOLDER}\n"
+    assert rows[1]["identities_redacted"] is True
+    # Lines with nothing to redact are left byte for byte.
+    assert lines[0] == original.splitlines(keepends=True)[0]
+    assert lines[2] == original.splitlines(keepends=True)[2]
+
+
+def test_jsonl_decorator_is_not_an_address(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    path = tmp_path / "inputs.jsonl"
+    path.write_text(json.dumps({"text": "\n\n@decorators.retry(3)"}) + "\n")
+
+    assert addresses_in(path) == set()
+    assert redact_file(path) == (set(), None)
